entities.name: Iyalode Wuraola Adepeju Esan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chief Wuraola Adepeju Esan (1909–1985) was a Nigerian teacher, feminist and politician. She combined her political ambitions with those of a traditional aristocrat by serving as the Iyalode of Ibadan.
